decisions.reason: As a core bread product with several years of presence, management is likely to continue it and interpret any weaker sales as temporary rather than abandon an invested-in line.
The sweet pastry sits close to the firm's established bakery business, so despite some assortment-overlap risk the firm is likely to stay committed rather than withdraw it quickly.
This farmhouse bread fits the firm's traditional bread identity and, having been added more recently, is likely to benefit from continued managerial commitment and patience.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen received a prominently advertised gold award, creating strong public commitment and giving management little reason to remove it.
The premium Christmas stollen was publicly backed by a gold award and aligns with a premium seasonal offering, so management is likely to retain it.
